description: This file defines a React functional component named CredentialsPanel that manages user credentials for AI providers, including listing, adding, editing, and deleting credentials, with associated UI modals, calls to external network functions, and integrations with hooks and UI libraries.

methods.name: handleUpdateCredential
methods.description: Handles the update of an existing credential by transforming form input, calling the update API, and refetching credentials.

methods.name: handleAddCredential
methods.description: Handles addition of new credential by transforming form input, calling create API, and refetching credentials.

methods.name: renderProviderBadge
methods.description: Renders a badge component with color coding based on provider name.

methods.name: handleDeleteCredential
methods.description: Handles deletion of a credential by calling the delete API and managing UI state.

methods.name: openDeleteModal
methods.description: Sets state to open the delete confirmation modal for a specific credential.
